question: What relative lengths are shown in Figure 6B-2 for a merging taper, shifting taper, and shoulder taper?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Figure 6B-2 shows the relative lengths of the different taper types as fractions of the computed taper length L. The merging taper is shown with a length of L, each shifting taper with a length of ½ L, and the shoulder taper with a length of ⅓ L. These proportions match the recommendations in Section 6B.08, and Table 6B-4 provides the formulas for calculating L. Guidance (recommended): - "The appropriate taper length (L) should be determined using the criteria shown in Tables 6B-3 and 6B-4." - "A shifting taper should have a length of approximately ½ L (see Tables 6B-3 and 6B-4)." - "If used, shoulder tapers should have a length of approximately ¹⁄3 L (see Tables 6B-3 and 6B-4). If a shoulder is used as a travel lane, either through practice or during a TTC activity, a normal merging or shifting taper should be used." Options (permitted): - "The lateral buffer space may be used to separate the traffic space from the work space, as shown in Figures 6B-1 and 6B-2." Support (informational): - "Tapers are created by using a series of channelizing devices and/or pavement markings to move traffic out of or into the normal path. Types of tapers are shown in Figure 6B-2. … Merging Taper at least L; Shifting Taper at least 0.5 L." Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 6B-2 labels the merging taper with a dimension of "L," two shifting tapers each dimensioned "1/2 L," and the shoulder taper dimensioned "1/3 L," along with an optional downstream taper and a "4S ft*" dimension (where S = speed in mph). [Image 3] Table 6B-4 provides the formulas for taper length L: L = WS²/60 for 40 mph or less, and L = WS for 45 mph or more. Citations: - Figure 6B-2 (p.774) - Section 6B.08 Guidance §4 (p.775) - Section 6B.08 Guidance §8 (p.776) - Section 6B.08 Guidance §10 (p.776) - Section 6B.08 Support §2 (p.775) - Section 6B.06 Option §14 (p.775) - Table 6B-4 (p.775)
gold_answer: Merging taper: L; shifting taper: 1/2 L; shoulder taper: 1/3 L.
